fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on government neglect and memorialization of victims of the 1928 Lake Okeechobee storm; criticism of Dade County coroner’s inquests and justice-of-the-peace jury practices; discussion of Miami policing levels and traffic accidents; and an article on Florida automobile taxes and road funding. Columns and notices cover the start of the winter/tourist season, the incoming sheriff (“Pop” Lehman), Miami Beach municipal court appointment, and assorted local items. Substantial entertainment and sports coverage/advertising appears for nightclubs, theatres, greyhound racing (Miami Beach and Coral Gables), and other events, alongside brief notes on prohibition enforcement and aviation activities (Pan-American air meet).
